load_eligibility_definition: Per wheel: recorded ground point count > 0 AND aggregate upward ground Fz > 5 N. Both requires both wheels. This is not a geometric-flight classifier.
reason: The candidate loses body orientation, nominal XY tracking, and measured two-wheel support. Smaller force jumps during loss of support are not a valid stability improvement.
next_isolated_diagnostic: Fixed successful baseline actor, configured contact solver velocity iterations 4 versus 8; keep position iterations 8, PD500/10, reference and mu unchanged. This is numerical sensitivity, not proof of converged physical truth.
